description: Convert YAML to JSON (YAML 1.2 core schema plus anchors/aliases, << merge keys, timestamps, multi-document files). Safe: no code tags (!!js/function, !!python… are rejected), alias bombs and recursive aliases are stopped. Several documents become a JSON array. Errors give line and column. Give "text" or a file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/yaml-json/

alwaysArray.description: Always output an array of documents, even for one document.

output.description: Optional: also write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/"). The result text is then left out of the reply. Results over 1,000,000 characters are always written to a file.

path.description: Or: a path to a YAML file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

sortKeys.description: Sort object keys alphabetically at every level.

name: yaml_to_json
title: YAML to JSON
